items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Bob Flanigan, trombonist, he came in and sat in with us.

ctx.x: Well you can’t please absolutely everybody. © Fillius Jazz Archive -33-

I don’t know what her problem was. We also — who else did we back? I’m just trying to think of who the heck else. Well Cal Tjader, he joined us for a while of course, and then for a while he had a trio at the Black Hawk so we had the two trios for a while and then when things started to get shaky and they cut his two men out and he played with us because Jerome left and Pony left. Pony left first, he went with Lionel Hampton. But he didn’t last very long. Then Jerome went with Hamp and he eventually came back.…
Well you’ve just about done it all.
